attackers_goals: Attackers attempt to log in to a remote host.
description: A user attempted to authenticate via SSH an excessive number of times in a short period. This may indicate a brute force attack.
investigative_actions: Verify any successful authentication by the user account referenced by the alert, as these can indicate the attacker managed to guess the credentials.
name: SSH authentication brute force attempts
